testA.description: 120 rapid viewport changes, coalescing should keep calls low (ideally 1-3)
testA.notes: ascii.resize called 119 times out of 120 viewport changes — coalescing ineffective for sequential ops (each rAF completes before next event)

testB.description: Resize 1280x800 -> 900x1000 -> 1280x800, check canvas dims, columns/rows, and render liveness
testB.notes: Canvas dimensions match window*dpr after resize cycle

testC.description: CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride DPR=2 then DPR=1, dimensions fixed at 1280x800
testC.notes: CDP override changed DPR to 2, canvas resized to 1920x1200 — app's DPR polling caught it

testD.notes: Render loop is alive after degenerate sizes
